name: MASD-Engineering-Toolbox
description: Offline engineering toolbox for Edwards ModuLaser MASD: device configuration, battery calculation (shared MASD engine), PipeCAD .pl import, legacy calculator migration and the field-change approval loop with the Commissioning Report. PWA + Windows.

paragraphs: Offline engineering toolbox for Edwards ModuLaser Modular Aspirating Smoke Detector (MASD) projects. It absorbs the ModuLaser Battery Calculator and adds device configuration, legacy-file migration and the field-change approval loop with the ModuLaser MASD Field (Commissioning) Report.

Version 00.02.000261016 — pre-release. 01.00.000 is reserved for the refined first release. Calculation engine: MASD engine 1.1.0 · Project file: modulaser-project 1.5.1 (.mlproj.json) · Calculator lineage: Battery Calculator 02.01.000
features: Web / PWA (live): — open in a browser, or install it (Chrome/Edge install icon; iPhone/iPad Safari → Share → Add to Home Screen). Works offline after the first visit.
The mode is stored in the project file (design.toolbox.mode). Switching never removes data.

For every detector and display: Alert, Prealarm, Fire 1, Fire 2 (absolute), Prealarm and Fire 1 delays, cascading, latching alarms/faults, flow-fault limits and delay, day/night (start hours), LDD, I/O assignments…

Validation: rising levels, ranges, FACU address format and duplicates, 16-character display names, Fire 1 vs the class hole limit. These values travel in design.devices[].config and replace the Commissioning Report's…

Set once per project (optional per-Area/Group overrides), carried in .mlproj.json (design.performance), printed on the Toolbox Configuration schedule and the Commissioning Report summary page. The Report checks each…
